verdict.rationale: The CLI docs include an option to "print TTFT and throughput statistics after each response" (vllm-docs-28). That implies a terminal command producing successive model responses, which fits an interactive chat client. The evidence never explicitly names a chat subcommand or describes the interactive session. Missing for 10: an explicit documented terminal chat command, a description of how the interactive session works (connecting to a server or a local model, multi-turn history, system prompts), and hands-on or community corroboration.
